dimensions.name: install_hooks
dimensions.label: Postinstall / preinstall script additions or changes
dimensions.reasoning: A new 'preinstall' hook is added (flagged in metadata as '+ preinstall'), executing preinstall.js. This script then runs platform-specific shell scripts (preinstall.bat on Windows via cmd.exe, preinstall.sh on Linux via /bin/bash) using child_process.exec/spawn. Introducing arbitrary shell execution at install time with no legitimate documented reason is a strong indicator of malicious activity. This matches the known ua-parser-js supply chain attack.

dimensions.reasoning: preinstall.js explicitly checks process.platform to branch between Windows (win32/win64), macOS (darwin), and Linux execution paths. This platform-conditional logic is used to execute different malicious payloads per OS, a well-known pattern in supply chain attacks.

llm_summary: This diff matches the well-documented ua-parser-js supply chain attack (CVE-2021-41265). A malicious preinstall hook was added that executes platform-specific shell scripts (preinstall.bat on Windows, preinstall.sh on Linux) via child_process at install time. Although the shell script contents are not included in the diff, this exact pattern was confirmed to install a cryptocurrency miner and credential-stealing malware. The install hook addition and platform-conditional execution logic are definitive high-risk indicators. This package version should be considered compromised.
